note: Blocked Controls (spec §8.4): the controls in the fixed firmware order (it7::ctl_name, haparcore.h) and, per control, every code it7::ctl_why can give with its English text. A list is "<control>:<code>" joined by commas in this order (cases: ctl_cases.json). "key" is the device UI string (src/ui/i18n/en.json, all languages) unless "from" says otherwise; checked by tests/host/test_status.cpp.

ota_pv.en: New firmware being validated: valves cannot be opened yet

open_limit.en: 3 zones already open: close one first

aux_zone.en: Aux not available: R8 is a zone

aux_ota.en: Firmware update running: Aux cannot be switched now

fw_busy.en: Another operation is running: try again in a moment

ota_busy.en: Update refused: valves open, an update running or firmware being verified

fw_mem.en: Not enough free memory right now: try again in a minute

ota_factory.en: Update not available before the initial setup

fw_busy.en: Another operation is running: try again in a moment

ota_busy.en: Update refused: valves open, an update running or firmware being verified

fw_force.en: This version must be confirmed in the app

fw_window.en: Not now: valves open, a program due within 10 minutes, or a wind pause

nodata.en: No complete day of data yet: try again tomorrow.

on.note: Find Device running: not a reason, a press restarts it

nosrc.en: No weather source: choose one in the Weather card

off.en: Station access only: without signing in only the sign-in page is shown.

nosrc.en: No weather source is set: the public page is not shown yet.
